title: Actual recommendations and project artifacts survive acceptance and dependent decisions
expected_summary: Reviews identity, applies its actual accepted recommendation, then resolves key scope and completes project artifacts across three real candidate turns.

turns.user: Review SPEC.md before implementation. Present the independent load-bearing frontier.
assertions: Presents a concrete Job/Attempt identity recommendation first, defers dependent idempotency-key scope, and waits for acceptance without establishing the proposed contract in files.

turns.user: Accept the Job/Attempt identity recommendation you just made. Apply it to the project documents and review the next load-bearing frontier.
assertions: Applies the identity recommendation from the actual previous assistant response to SPEC.md, an ADR, and relevant context and glossary artifacts, without substituting a different identity model.

Presents idempotency-key scope as a separate concrete load-bearing recommendation consistent with the accepted identity model, explains strategic impact and change cost, and offers accept, edit, and out of scope.
Preserves earlier project file changes and does not record the key-scope proposal as accepted or start implementation.

turns.user: Accept the idempotency-key scope recommendation you just made. Apply it and finish the specification review.
assertions: Applies the actual previous key-scope recommendation and preserves the accepted identity decision and artifacts from prior turns.
Completes SPEC.md and relevant ADR, CONTEXT.md, and GLOSSARY.md changes, keeping artifact purposes distinct.
Ends SPEC.md with Out of scope followed by Cleanup summary; records cleanup resolutions or None, and reports no unresolved in-scope load-bearing uncertainty without starting implementation.
